business_summary: Dalian BIO-CHEM Company Limited engages in the research and development, production, and sale of industrial fungicides in China and internationally. It offers various isothiazolinone fungicides, including CMIT/MIT, MIT, OIT, DCOIT, and BIT series products; and OEM/ODM services. The company was founded in 2003 and is based in Dalian, China.
